# Mizan Legal Digital Platform

> Comprehensive academic and legal archive for law students and researchers in Morocco.

## Core Navigation
- [Academic Archive](https://www.mizan.page/archive): Semester 1 to Semester 6 study materials.
- [Legal Library](https://www.mizan.page/library): Legal texts, books, and reference material.
- [Jurisprudence](https://www.mizan.page/jurisprudence): Moroccan case law and court rulings.
- [Law Schools](https://www.mizan.page/schools): Directory of legal faculties across Morocco.
